provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: form-action * lets a form post anywhere, so a single markup injection can exfiltrate input and must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: Form submission does not require script execution. With every origin allowed, an injected form action can send the user's input to any host while the policy still blocks script.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The rule does not model which forms exist on the page.
